estimates.assumptions: 1 tablespoon dried mint weighs ~2.4g based on typical density of dried herbs (about 0.8-1 tsp per gram); calories reflect standard value for dried spearmint/peppermint leaves.

Medium-large cucumber assumed at ~300g whole; this is the typical edible weight after minimal trimming for a '1 cucumber' line (standard range 250-400g); known caloriesPer100g copied exactly as supplied for raw cucumber.
